items.title: 4.4 Gases ka molar mass aur kasafat (density) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.4, printed page 80.

blocks.title: Kasafat (density)
blocks.text: Kasafat (density) kisi madde ka fi unit hajm mass hai: d = m / V.

Kyunke STP par har gas ka ek molar mass ek hi hajm leta hai, gas ki density us ke molar mass par munhasir hai: zyada molar mass wali gas ki density zyada aur ulat. Agar STP par gas ki density naap li jaye to us ka molar mass mass = density x hajm se nikal sakta hai, ek mole ka hajm 22.4 dm3 lete hue. Sample Problem 4.9: STP par 1.97 g/dm3 density wali gas ka molar mass 1.97 x 22.4 = 44.1 g/mol hai.

blocks.prompt: Us gas ka molar mass nikalein jis ki STP par density 1.34 g/dm3 hai, aur doosri ka jis ki 1.43 g/dm3 hai. Yeh kaun si aam gases ho sakti hain?
blocks.explanation: 1.34 x 22.4 = 30.0 g/mol, jo ethane (C2H6) ya nitric oxide (NO) se milta hai. 1.43 x 22.4 = 32.0 g/mol, jo oxygen, O2, se milta hai.

items: Density d = m / V; STP par har gas ka ek mole 22.4 dm3 mein hai, to molar mass = density x 22.4 (1.97 g/dm3 se 44.1 g/mol).
